training_order: Round-robin the seven supplemental groups and any formal legacy layouts absent from the frozen independently verified retained roster. Repeat that catalog on fresh physical starts.
family_rule: For grid indices x,y in 0..7 use family 8*y+x, with residue (x+3*y) mod 8. Apply the grid offsets (dx,dy), (-dy,dx), (-dx,-dy), (dy,-dx) to the four registered slots respectively.

evaluation_schedule.family: ascending allowed family IDs indexed by (i+repetition) modulo family count

evaluation_claim: New physical conditions for the full legal single-transfer catalog. The previous unseen-structure benchmark is reserved for its original model and split.
